01 · The Sound

The Sound

The SelDom sound is rooted in progressive electronic music, bringing together depth, organic rhythms, psychedelic elements and melody.

Rather than being defined by a single genre, their selections develop gradually. Each transition carries the music forward while leaving space for emotion, tension and release to emerge naturally.

02 · The Journey

The Journey

Every SelDom set is shaped in the moment.

The music responds to the space, the people and what develops between them. Earthy and primal passages can open into expansive and uplifting states, allowing the atmosphere to evolve without following a predetermined path.

Rhythm becomes a language beyond words, and the dancefloor itself becomes part of the unfolding experience.

03 · The Ritual

The Ritual

At the heart of SelDom is the understanding of dance as something deeper than entertainment.

The dancefloor can become a space of reconnection, where attention turns inward without losing contact with what is happening around it.

Through conscious movement, the body becomes an active part of the experience rather than simply a response to the music.

There are moments when the boundary between artist and dancefloor naturally dissolves. In this space, an encounter with the inner self becomes possible, while remaining part of something collective.

04 · The Artists

Two approaches.
One movement.

CELESTE_YAR

Celeste_yar approaches sound through energy, conscious movement and intuitive awareness.

With a background in energy healing and sacred arts, she is particularly attentive to the subtle shifts within a space and to the relationship that develops between music, body and collective energy.

Her presence is not necessarily confined to the DJ booth. At times she moves onto the dancefloor, becoming part of the experience from within and allowing the exchange between artist and audience to become immediate and physical.

For her, dance is a form of inner expression and a way of reconnecting with the Sacred through Art.

DUALISM

Dualism holds a strong focus on the musical architecture of the set.

He explores the transformative qualities of rhythm through careful selection, progression and transition, building long-form narratives with depth, momentum and space.

Balancing the underground pulse with openness and elevation, he allows the music to develop patiently, maintaining the thread that carries the experience from one state into the next.

His relationship with sound is grounded in its physical power while remaining open to its subtler dimensions.

05 · Invisible World

Invisible World

SelDom on Cannibal Radio

Invisible World is SelDom’s ongoing podcast on Cannibal Radio. A space for extended sessions, allowing the music to unfold with greater freedom beyond the format of a conventional DJ set.
